act.name: Information Technology Act, 2000
act.source_name: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY), Government of India
act.description: Primary law in India dealing with cybercrime, e-commerce, digital signatures, and unauthorized access to computer systems.

sections.title: Punishment for identity theft
sections.text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.
sections.plain_language_summary: Fraudulent use of another person's password, OTP, signature, or online identity is identity theft, punishable by up to 3 years imprisonment.

sections.title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
sections.text: Whoever, by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personation, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.
sections.plain_language_summary: Online financial scams, phishing, fake website fraud, and unauthorized digital fund transfers are punishable by up to 3 years imprisonment.
